comment: App Store screenshot captions per locale. This file is the source of truth (first drafted in the per-language plans, docs/archive/localization-2026-07/<lang>.md §4; tr puts the multicurrency frame first). Frame keys map to raw capture files: home=01-home, finances=02-finances, insights=03-insights, score=04-health-score, topcat=05-top-category, history=06-history, voice=07-voice (Ten's voice sheet), fx=08-multicurrency, ten=13-ten-answers (Ten answers on cards), draft=14-ten-drafts (Ten's draft with Save), goal=15-goal (a goal's detail with the monthly amount), debts=16-debts (the debts list, one overdue). The App Store takes 10 frames: debts and insights are captured but not in defaultOrder. Custom product page frames (ru, en-US, fr-FR only): subscriptions=09-subscriptions, subscription=10-subscription-detail, deposit=11-deposit, loans=12-loans; the pages and their frame order are in appstore/product-pages.json.
